gaps.sentence: He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
She waited ___ (ANXIOUS) by the phone for news.
He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.
